mostWorthwhile.text: Putting the cartilage-capped bones inside the lined sleeve was most worthwhile: the explanation connected both cartilage and fluid to smooth movement.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final sequence became predictable because there was only one available combination at each step, though it was clear what the parts did.

surprise.text: I was surprised that nutrients reach living bone cells through tiny fluid-filled channels while blood cells stay inside the vessel.

arbitrary.text: None felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures showed how the parts fit or what jobs they did.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter to see how other body parts fit together. The elbow build was clear, although I would hope for more meaningful choices.
